manual_migration_required.title: Manual Upgrade Required for MirAIe India
manual_migration_required.description: MirAIe India 2.0 introduces independent per-device entries and IR blaster support. Auto-migration could not split your legacy account entry automatically. Please delete the old 'MirAIe Cloud Account' entry under Settings -> Devices & Services -> MirAIe India and re-add your account via Add Integration. All your existing entity names, automations, and dashboards will be preserved seamlessly!

migration_successful.title: Migrated to MirAIe 2.0 — IR Blaster Setup Available
migration_successful.description:
Your Panasonic AC integration has been successfully updated to MirAIe 2.0!

If you want to set up local IR control or hybrid failover for your Wi-Fi AC unit:
1. Go to **Settings -> Devices & Services -> MirAIe India**.
2. Click the **Configure (Settings Cog)** next to your AC device.
3. Select your **IR Blaster / Transmitter** entity.
